basic_info.description: Russian Hill Fairy Tale come true! Meander down lush Macondray Lane and experience quintessential storybook SF. Situated on a quaint flora-filled lane, featured in Armistead Maupin's Tales of the City, 62 Macondray Lane is a light-filled1BR/1BA condo with captivating views of the Bay, Alcatraz, Angel Island, Coit Tower and beyond.  Hardwood floors & original wood-burning fireplace add to the charm of this home. Kitchen is complete with gas cooking & stainless steel appliances. A large storage room is included in this boutique Victorian building.  Perfect for first time buyer or pied'terre, near fabulous restaurants and cafes of neighboring North Beach - an enviable location!
